en: One, Two, or Three Days: Leave Room in the Valley
zh: 一、二、三天：给河谷留出空白
ja: 一日・二日・三日：河谷に余白を残す

p.src: Do not count Lanzhou by hotel nights alone. An early train into Lanzhou West may leave almost a full day once the bags are put away; a midday airport arrival can leave only an afternoon after the transfer and check-in. From a high view of the valley, the four guides divide their route notebook into four lines: where the bags go, the one place that anchors the day, where to stop for a seated meal, and how to return to the hotel or departure point. Until those lines have answers, do not add a fifth place name. Lanzhou stretches east-west, so one unnecessary reversal can take away time for lunch, the galleries, or a climb. Count the hours that can actually be used, then choose either the river or Gansu Provincial Museum as the day's main line.

caption.zh: 从白塔山一侧俯瞰，黄河铁桥只占河谷的一处横断面；真正决定路线的是下一站在东还是西、在南岸还是北岸。
caption.ja: 白塔山側から見下ろすと、黄河鉄橋は長い河谷の一つの横断地点にすぎない。経路を決めるのは、次が東西どちらか、南北どちらの岸かである。
caption.en: From the White Pagoda Hill side, the Yellow River Iron Bridge occupies one crossing in a long valley. The next stop's east-west position and riverbank determine the route.

p.src: In the one-day lane, ‘river or museum’ is a choice, not one stop for the morning and the other for the afternoon. With two days, keep the museum day and bridge day separate; when the booking or weather does not fit, swap the whole days. A third day keeps those two days intact and only then adds one hill or an unhurried old-city walk. If Day 2 already included the full White Pagoda Hill climb, do not add Lanshan or Wuquan on Day 3. Every lane ends with the return because reaching the hotel, collecting bags, or catching booked transport consumes real time. Arrows show editorial order only. They are not walking paths, metro lines, roads, journey times, or a promise that an entrance is open on the travel date.

caption.zh: 一天先在沿河和省博物馆之间选一条；两天分开博物馆日和过桥日；第三天只加一处高点或一段老城慢走。
caption.ja: 一日は川沿いか博物館、二日は博物館の日と橋の日、三日目は高所一か所か旧市街の散策だけを加える。
caption.en: Choose river or museum for one day; separate museum and bridge across two; add only one hill or an old-city walk on Day 3.

p.src: When the bags are settled in the central segment and conditions suit outdoor walking, give the day to Zhongshan Bridge. Eat a bowl of beef noodles near the route that morning rather than crossing the city for a famous shop. On the south bank, identify the General Pillar and the bridge approach, then cross. Choose one way to use the north bank. If energy, visibility, and current access all support it, make the full White Pagoda Hill climb. Otherwise stop on the lower terraces, see how the bridge, river, and hills line up, and turn back. After descending, keep either one riverfront section or one seated meal. Do not add the provincial museum, Lanshan, or Wuquan. When the day starts after lunch, remove the full climb; do not reduce the bridge to a hurried link between other stops.

caption.zh: 五孔钢桁架横过黄河，白塔山从北岸抬起。先认出桥、山和塔，再决定上山深度。
caption.ja: 五つの鋼トラス径間の先に白塔山が立ち上がる。橋、山、塔の順を確かめてから、どこまで上るかを決める。
caption.en: Five steel truss spans cross the Yellow River as White Pagoda Hill rises from the north bank. Identify bridge, hill, and pagoda before choosing the climb.

p.src: When the booking is secured, the museum is open, and you are starting from Lanzhou West or Qilihe, make Gansu Provincial Museum the day's only major stop. Store large bags first and enter from the Xijin West Road side after breakfast. Check which galleries are open that day, then visit painted pottery on the third floor, Buddhist art on the same floor, and Silk Road civilization on the second. If a famous object is off display, keep the route and study another well-labelled piece. After leaving, sit down for lunch and record one object's title, date or type, and where it was found. If you still have energy, continue slowly towards Xiguan or the hotel; if not, finish. Do not rush to Zhongshan Bridge after leaving, and do not treat a whole hill as a quick dusk add-on.

caption.zh: 灰白石材的长立面围住中央入口。先认建筑，再在门厅确认当天展厅与重点文物。
caption.ja: 淡い石張りの長い正面に中央入口が開く。建物を確認し、館内で当日の展示室と主要資料を確かめる。
caption.en: A long pale-stone frontage frames the central entrance. Recognize the building, then confirm today's galleries and key objects inside.

p.src: ‘Day 1’ here means the museum day; it need not literally be your first day in the city. Schedule it around your reservation and an opening day, and swap the complete museum day with the bridge day when needed. From a western hotel, eat near the starting point and finish the day moving east. From a central hotel, make one westward journey and return once after the museum instead of crossing the valley repeatedly. Choose a beef-noodle shop close to the start, open that day, and where the ordering steps are clear. One bowl is enough. After the museum, eat lunch and rest before taking only one stretch around Xiguan, the Lanzhou Prefecture City God Temple area, or the route back to the hotel. Enter any courtyard only under that day's access rules. Keep dinner near the lodging segment. Do not cross the river or climb a hill on this day.

caption.zh: 先认清汤、白萝卜、红辣子、绿香菜或蒜苗与面条；牛肉和鸡蛋按需要另加。
caption.ja: 澄んだスープ、白い大根、赤い辣子、緑の香菜または蒜苗、麺を先に見て、牛肉と卵は必要な時だけ加える。
caption.en: Read clear broth, white radish, red chilli oil, green coriander or garlic shoots, and noodles first; add beef or egg only when wanted.

p.src: Base the second day in the central segment; do not return west for displays missed the day before. After breakfast, approach Zhongshan Bridge from the south bank and make White Pagoda Hill the day's only hill. Continue to the pagoda precinct only if the path is open, you have the energy, the weather is suitable, and visibility is worthwhile. Otherwise turn back at the lower terraces. That shorter version still shows how the iron bridge meets the north-bank slope. After descending, drink water and sit down for a meal before choosing either a short riverfront return or a direct trip to the hotel for bags. Lanshan and Wuquan remain choices for a three-day plan; they do not belong on the same day as White Pagoda Hill. If a train is booked that evening, write down the time you must turn back and cut the riverfront extension first.

caption.zh: 七级白塔立在紧凑塔院与层叠公园之上。到入口再选下层台地或完整登高，不把所有屋顶看成同一时代。
caption.ja: 七層の白塔が小さな境内と段状の公園の上に立つ。入口で下段までか白塔寺の境内までかを選び、すべての屋根を同時代とは見なさない。
caption.en: The seven-level pagoda rises above a compact precinct and terraced park. Choose the lower terraces or full climb at the entrance, and do not treat every roof as one historical layer.

p.src: Day 3 is not for putting back every stop removed from the first two days. If Day 2 stopped on White Pagoda Hill's lower terraces, today's visibility and energy are suitable, and the ascent, descent, and return have been confirmed, choose either Lanshan or Wuquan. If the full White Pagoda climb is already complete, do not climb another hill merely to fill the schedule. Lanshan shows how the Yellow River valley extends east-west; verify the ascent and descent separately. Wuquan offers a slower landscape of parkland, courtyards, and historic buildings, and should be cancelled for rain or a park-clearance notice. Santai Pavilion and the city view in the figure explain why someone might choose Lanshan; they promise neither clear sky, sunset, nor year-round transport. Apart from the hill, keep only a seated meal and a dependable return, not another museum or bridge visit.

caption.zh: 到三台阁，看的不是一幢高楼，而是兰州如何沿黄河谷向东西展开；出发前仍要核对能见度、上山路和回程。
caption.ja: 三台閣で見るのは一棟の高い建物ではなく、蘭州が黄河の谷に沿って東西へ延びる形である。出発前に視界、上り道、帰路を確かめる。
caption.en: At Santai Pavilion, read not one skyline building but the way Lanzhou extends east-west along the Yellow River valley. Check visibility, access, and the return before setting out.

p.src: When visibility is poor, heat or cold makes exposed walking unpleasant, legs need recovery, or either the ascent or descent is unclear, keep the third day on the valley floor. Begin at Xiguan and follow one stretch of the old-city streets towards the Lanzhou Prefecture City God Temple area. Enter the courtyard under the rules on site when it is open; when it is not, continue rather than waiting at the gate. Choose one place to sit for sanpaotai or lunch, read the notes from the first two days, and only then decide whether to add a short south-bank walk. This plan does not join every old street into a route or repeat the whole bridge. It still shows the scale of the streets, everyday food habits, and the city's historical layers, while leaving time for laundry, buying supplies for the next leg, and an early return to the hotel.

caption.zh: 灰瓦、彩绘斗拱和红柱留在密集的现代街区里；先看当天能进入哪一进院落，再沿张掖路读老城。
caption.ja: 灰色の瓦、彩色の組物、赤い柱が密集した現代市街に残る。当日入れる中庭を確かめてから、張掖路で旧市街を読む。
caption.en: Grey tiles, painted brackets, and red columns survive inside a dense modern district. Check which courtyards are accessible that day, then read the old city along Zhangye Road.

p.src: Make only three groups of checks the night before: the museum booking and opening, forecast, warnings, and visibility, and the ascent, descent, and return for the chosen hill. Use them for one decision in the morning. If the museum is closed or unavailable and outdoor conditions fit, use the river day. If rain or poor visibility rules out a hill and the museum is booked and open, use the museum day. During heavy rain, stay in a reliable indoor place or rest. Use the ground-level old-city walk only when the hill is being cleared or its descent is uncertain but conditions in the city remain safe for walking. In heat or cold, shorten exposed time and keep enough room to drink, adjust layers, sit down for a meal, and return. Long-term climate information can prompt preparation for dryness and temperature swings; it cannot answer today's conditions. After removing a hill, do not compensate by adding three streets.

p.src: Put bags, meals, bookings, and the return on one clock. Count the arrival day from when the bags are settled. On checkout, decide where the bags go and verify the booked station or terminal. Choose an onward service with a safe connection, not the timetable's final departure. Add station wayfinding, waiting, walking, security, and toilet time. If missing the next departure risks a reservation, cut the extra snack, second street, then outdoor climb. Keep documents, bags, rest, a seated meal, official safety instructions, and a dependable return. Three hotel nights may hold only two full city days. Build those first; leave the rest for arrival and departure.
